- memory_id "1000230" [decision]: Team Ember does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember)
- memory_id "1000225" [constraint]: Changes to the authentication gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000211": Team Dune holds a planning meeting every Wednesday.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000164" [constraint]: The flags service moved from Team Atlas to Cinder as of 2025-02-13.  (about: Team Atlas, Cinder, flags service)
- memory_id "1000160": Priya walked Diego through the flags service runbook on 2025-02-13.  (about: Priya, Diego, flags service)
- memory_id "1000149": The reporting service depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export.  (about: Ledger, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000138": The authentication gateway lives with team Ember.  (about: Ember, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000132": Ember owns the job scheduler.  (about: Ember, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000126": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000120": Team Dune owns image-resizer.  (about: Team Dune, image-resizer)
- memory_id "1000095" [decision]: The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000091" [decision]: The first on-call rotation for Team Dune goes to Farah.  (about: Team Dune, Farah)
- memory_id "1000084": Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember as of 2025-01-10.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000051": Farah is the sole member of Team Dune as of 2025-01-09.  (about: Team Dune, Farah)
- memory_id "1000048": Team Dune is a one-person team as of 2025-01-09.  (about: Team Dune)
